title: Zebra table
summary: Shade the header and every other row, without adding any classes.
brief: The header row has a #fed7aa background.
In the body, every even row (the 2nd and 4th) has a #fff7ed background; odd rows stay white.
Do not add classes to the rows: select them by their position.
hints: There is a pseudo-class that selects children by their position: :nth-child().
:nth-child(even) matches the 2nd, 4th, 6th… child. Count is per parent, so rows in tbody are counted from tbody’s first row.
.prices th { background-color: #fed7aa; } and .prices tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: #fff7ed; }
solutionNotes: :nth-child(even) counts each row’s position among its siblings, so the pattern stays right however many rows there are, and nobody has to remember to add a class. Rows in thead and tbody have separate parents, which is why the count starts again inside tbody.
